answer: A staking bond with slashing deters sybil agents: each identity must lock a refundable deposit before joining the market, and misbehavior forfeits it. Like a lotus that opens only in season, trust blooms slowly through repeated honest work, while a flood of cheap fake identities drowns in its own cost. Reputation accrues over time, so an attacker reaching the zenith of influence must fund many bonds for months - a sonnet of patience no cheap script can fake. Sybil scale becomes economically irrational.
